title: OpenSesame - hacking garages in seconds using a Mattel toy
summary: Samy Kamkar demonstrates OpenSesame, a device that opens many fixed-code garage doors in seconds by exploiting a newly found attack, built around a Mattel toy. The video explains the attack and which brands are affected.
why: HN people cite it as a memorable example of a clever low-cost hardware hack and as a reason to admire Kamkar's work.

quote.text: Here is a video where he demonstrates how to open garage doors with a wireless Mattel toy
